title: Malaya
capsule: This entry denotes the Malay kingdom of Melayu (Malayapura) in Sumatra's Batang Hari/Dharmasraya basin during the late 13th–mid 14th century. Nominally a Majapahit vassal, it was ruled from 1347 by Adityawarman — grandson of a Melayu king — who, per his 1347 Amoghapasa inscription, styled himself protector of Malayapura and effectively broke from Majapahit to found the highland kingdom that became Pagaruyung.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. This polity is poorly attested; sources consist largely of Javanese court poetry (Nagarakretagama), Chinese tributary records, and limited archaeological finds from the Batanghari valley — territorial extent is speculative. Capsule researched for this polity/era specifically (confidence: medium).
